complexity.notes: math.comb performs O(min(m, n)) multiplications, which is optimal for this formula; any bit-level cost of the large intermediate integers is not counted per convention. The snippet relies on the judge pre-importing the math module; adding an explicit import math would make it self-contained. This is a strict improvement over the previous O(m*n) DP in both time and space.
complexity.summary: Replaces the DP table with the closed-form answer: the number of monotone paths is the binomial coefficient C(m+n-2, m-1), computed directly via math.comb.
